title: Kusanagi Nene — Swept Up In The Edo Streets〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Swept Up In The Edo Streets（2★）

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, this idiom means...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Three pages left...
I'm finally halfway through these worksheets...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Once I'm done with my English homework, I'll do those math problems next and then...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(So much to do. But it's also my fault for letting it all pile up while practicing for our shows...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
And I'm starting to lose focus...
I should take a break.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene, you're taking a break?
Then, I'll join you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nice work, you two!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks.
Hm? What are you all up to?
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, MEIKO☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We heard that Nene and Emu were having a study session together, so we decided to come watch♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A study session...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I thought you two got fairly good grades. Is there a reason you felt that you needed to gather like this...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene invited me after telling me she was gonna do some studying in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was getting through my homework, but I had trouble focusing at home...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really?
Why's that☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, were you about to fall asleep?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She isn't you, Luka. I'm sure there's a different reason.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, so... This game I've been playing a lot just got a big update recently...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I had to fight the urge to procrastinate.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It must've been a very big update.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It was.
They added this new mode with its own special rules...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They even added new maps, characters and story content. They definitely put a lot of effort into this update...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds like fun♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, I didn't have a chance to play for a while since we were at Jidaigeki Studio Park doing performances until just recently. I sorta couldn't stop myself...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I soon realized that I wouldn't be able to get through any of the homework I let pile up if I kept playing. So, I decided to call Emu and seek refuge in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm sorry about this, Emu...
I know I'm dragging you into my own problems.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I've actually been having a lot of fun doing my homework with you, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks. I'm glad you're saying that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In any case, you want to get through your homework and play that game as fast as possible, right?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, it must be incredibly fun if you had trouble stopping yourself, Nene.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be fun to quickly square away your homework and play it with Emu?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, why don't we all help with their homework so they can get to playing that game?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, then!
I'm gonna be your cheerleader♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, I'll study with you two so that I can jump in and help whenever you get stuck.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO, that's so nice of you. It's like you're their teacher♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Umm... I'll be a cheerleader with Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's go, Nene!
Let's go, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. You hear that, Nene?!
They're all gonna help us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's finish up our homework so we can play that game together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, we'll do our best to finish these assignments.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Coming here was a good decision...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Not just because I've been able to get through these homework assignments...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But because the others are making this process as much fun as playing that game.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, you've got such a big smile on your face!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Were you thinking about playing that game?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? No, I was just...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, let's work together and give these two all the help we can so that they smile even more!

rows.Speaker: Len, Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!
